about: Golden vectors of the doctor rows that read the runner config or the machine it names: generated paths, executor confinement, git write grants, capability serves sets, omp natives, agy sub-HOMEs and the tool registry posture. A vector is { name, row, runner?, machine?, expect }; expect is { passed, message }, the sentence each row shows (first recorded from the Node judges before they were deleted; the Rust judges are the owner now, and a change to one is a change to its vector). machine describes what a row reads of the machine: omp (null: not installed; { output } or { exit }: what omp --version does), env, files, dirs, platform, arch, pathCommands; paths begin with $ROOT, the directory the machine is built under, and $ROOT/home is the home.
